name: AI Shorts — topic to mock publish

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ topic: $json.body.topic || $json.topic, script_provider: 'auto', voice_provider: 'auto', publish: true, dry_run: true, scheduled_at: $json.body.scheduled_at || null }) }}

parameters.content:
## Portfolio demo

POST `{ "topic": "how to explain a hard idea" }` to this webhook.

The pipeline writes the script, voiceover, vertical MP4, and mock Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube receipts. `dry_run` stays true so nothing is posted.

Set `SHORTS_API_BASE` on the n8n instance, for example `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Start the API with `shorts-pipeline serve`.

The same job from a shell:

`shorts-pipeline run --topic "how to explain a hard idea" --publish`
